observed_current_task_cost_proxy.caveat: Two different task sets, not confidence limits or bounds on longer multi-day tasks; observed cache hit rates may not recur.

original_source.reproduction_cost_formula: measured original cost per work unit * required matched units + planning/meetings/summaries and recorded failures/retries
original_source.same_current_short_task_proxy: conditional illustration only; original request structure and context differ
original_source.golden_rule: Only generate if original can support common executable task contracts; otherwise report original artifact oracle not measurable.

expert_rating.cash_formula: 36*r to 72*r, excluding evidence preparation/training/challenge ground-truth review/adjudication

reuse_original_snapshot_current_generati.excludes: original acquisition/adaptation, planning/meetings/summaries, engineering, expert and compute costs

removed_from_default_budget.rule_template: optional implementation and local compute only

pilot_current_generation_plus_60_calibra.original_generation: 0 if snapshot reuse; otherwise unmeasured extra

excluded_unmeasured_costs: original architecture reproduction and API compatibility
new current planning/meetings/email/summaries beyond task requests
developer and fixture/attack truth review time
longer packets or additional judge escalation after pilot
optional ablations, rule/single-shot/statistical generators and extra blind packages
quality_rules: pilot measures original and current complete generation costs separately
main sources O and N must be provenanced; current legacy toggle is not original
do not charge same generation again in stage3
budget limits never convert missing evidence or incomplete evaluation to PASS
